text:
liz_sales: Acme follow-up: they prefer PrivateLink-only POC (no TGW). Need a hand with endpoint acceptance, DNS, and minimal SG/NACL rules. Also asked about Dedicated vs Private pricing for the POC. Can SE/infra advise?

sam_se: Good to know. For PrivateLink-only the main items: create interface endpoints in their VPC, provide subnet IDs for ENIs (one per AZ recommended), and we need to approve the connection from our service side.

omar_cloudeng: Networking checklist from infra side:
- Subnets: private subnets with available ENI IPs in each AZ. Avoid /28s; suggest /24 or larger per subnet.
- Security groups: endpoint SG should allow inbound from our service IPs on TCP/443 and TCP/15001 (if using health checks). Outbound to our control plane on 443.
- NACLs: keep stateless rules broad enough for ephemeral ports (1024-65535) for egress.

sam_se: We'll provide the endpoint service name they must use when creating the interface endpoint: `com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d` (placeholder). We'll also set service to require acceptance so we can validate requests.

jen_sre: DNS notes: if they want in-VPC hostnames to resolve to the VPCE private IPs enable "Private DNS" on the endpoint OR create Route53 A records in their private hosted zone pointing to the ENI IPs. Private DNS is easiest but has implications if they use split-horizon.

liz_sales: They asked about certs and SNI for traffic to the endpoint. Any constraints?

sam_se: No client certs required for now. We use TLS with a SAN cert that covers the internal hostnames. If they do mTLS on their side, we'll need to coordinate cert bundle exchange. For SNI, ensure their clients send the expected hostname or the TLS handshake may not match.

omar_cloudeng: Acceptance flow we expect:
1) Customer creates interface endpoint -> sends VPCE ID to us (vpce-0abc1234).
2) We review and accept (if service requires manual acceptance).
3) Customer validates ENI attachment and performs DNS resolution.
4) We run connectivity tests from our side and ask them to curl endpoints from inside VPC.

infra-bot: :white_check_mark: POC ticket created POC-2788. Add subnet IDs as a comment to this thread to attach.

jen_sre: Quick curl example for customer to test after acceptance:

```
curl -v --resolve api.redwood.local:443:10.0.5.12 https://api.redwood.local/health
```

Replace IP with endpoint ENI private IP.

liz_sales: They also want a short SG/NACL template to copy. Can we provide minimal rules?

omar_cloudeng: Minimal SG (customer side) copy-paste:

```
# Allow inbound from VPC CIDR to endpoint ENIs (if app calls via private DNS)
Type: Custom TCP  Port: 443  Source: <app-subnet-cidr>
Type: Custom TCP  Port: 15001 Source: <healthcheck-subnet-cidr>
Outbound: HTTPS 443 0.0.0.0/0 (or restrict to our control plane CIDRs)
```

NACL: allow inbound ephemeral ports 1024-65535 for ephemeral responses, allow outbound 443.

sam_se: Pricing question: For short POC (2-4 weeks) Private (self-hosted) involves infra + license. Dedicated (Redwood-managed reserved pool) usually simpler and cheaper for short trials since no infra setup. But PrivateLink-only can be used with both models; pricing differs. I'll loop in sales ops for exact numbers.

liz_sales: I'll ask Acme which model they'd like. For now send them the endpoint svc name + the checklist.

jen_sre: One extra gotcha: corporate proxies sometimes rewrite Host headers -> can break SNI. Ask them to test with a direct VPC hop (ec2 or bastion) and provide curl output if failures.

liz_sales: Action items I'll send to customer:
- Provide VPC ID + CIDRs (confirm no overlap with our infra 10.210.0.0/16).
- Provide private subnet IDs (one per AZ) for interface endpoints and allocate ENI IPs.
- Create interface endpoint using our svc name and share VPCE IDs.
- Provide sample curl output if they hit TLS/hostname errors.
- Indicate whether they prefer Dedicated-managed POC or Private deployment.

infra-bot: :information_source: Note: tag resources `redwood:pocteam=acme` so infra can find them quickly.

liz_sales: Thanks all — sending now. Will post VPCE IDs here when they reply. :rocket:
